# Code of Conduct

This demo follows the community principles in [OpenNHP’s Code of Conduct](https://github.com/OpenNHP/opennhp/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md), which is based on [Contributor Covenant 2.0](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/0/code_of_conduct/). This local policy applies to participation in this repository; it does not make OpenNHP’s maintainers responsible for moderating this demo.

## Community standards

Everyone should be able to participate without harassment or discrimination, regardless of background, identity, ability, or experience.

- Communicate respectfully and consider other perspectives.
- Give constructive feedback about the work, rather than attacking the person.
- Take responsibility for mistakes and respect requests to stop harmful behavior.
- Protect others’ privacy and obtain permission before sharing personal information.

Harassment, threats, discriminatory remarks, sexualized behavior, personal attacks, and disclosure of private information are unacceptable.

## Scope and moderation

These standards cover issues, pull requests, reviews, and other project spaces, as well as public activity officially representing this demo. Repository maintainers may moderate content, restrict participation, or remove access. Responses should be proportionate to the severity and pattern of behavior, ranging from a correction or warning to temporary restrictions or a permanent ban.

## Reporting concerns

For conduct in this repository, use GitHub’s **Report content** option on the relevant content or the [GitHub abuse reporting form](https://github.com/contact/report-abuse). Include links and enough context to identify the concern. Do not expose a reporter’s identity or sensitive evidence in a public issue. For direct maintainer contact, use only contact details the [repository owner](https://github.com/justingreerbbi) has explicitly published; no separate private reporting address is designated here.

Concerns about participation in upstream OpenNHP spaces should follow the reporting process in [OpenNHP’s Code of Conduct](https://github.com/OpenNHP/opennhp/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). That upstream channel is separate from this repository’s moderation.

Maintainers should handle reports fairly, limit disclosure to what is necessary to address the concern, and avoid retaliation against anyone who raises a concern in good faith.

## Attribution

This is a project-specific summary and adaptation of the principles in OpenNHP’s policy and Contributor Covenant 2.0. Consult the linked upstream policy for its full standards, enforcement guidance, and attribution.
